text:
zoe (Docs): Quick sync: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4277 is failing preview. Two main problems: the Console prefetch dashboard panel returns 404 in preview, and several observability snippets still use old keys (`trace_hook`, `cost_breakdown`). Can we triage?

mik (Eng): I looked at the preview logs. The panel JSON in docs/console/observability/prefetch.md references metric id `telemetry.prefetch.lat_v0`. That was renamed during telemetry cleanup; change to `telemetry.prefetch.lat`. I'll open a tiny patch.

anya (Observability): I'll take the panel JSON and run the dashboard schema validator. Also noticed the sample had `experimental: true` which should not be in public examples. Removing that.

zoe (Docs): thanks. Also the live embed points to /playground/embed.js which moved to /playground/embeds/embed.js — that causes the 404. Please update the path in the markdown.

rafe (SDK): For snippets, I propose a short compatibility shim in the snippet-runner to accept both `trace_hook` and `tracehook` during the rollout. Helper will be two lines and we keep it for one release. I'll also update docs snippets to the new param.

mik (Eng): pushed the metric id fix and removed the experimental flag. Still seeing a broken playground path; I'll update the embed reference in the same branch.

ci-bot: PR 4277  sample-link-check FAILED: 3 broken links, 1 snippet-lint warning. See https://ci.redwood-inference.net/ci/4277/logs

anya (Observability): schema validator locally passed after the metric change but flagged missing `prefetch.enabled` boolean. Added it and reformatted JSON for clarity. Pushed.

rafe (SDK): updated snippet tests to expect `tracehook` and added one test to accept `trace_hook` until shim removed. Also grepped for `cost_breakdown` and replaced two examples with `cost.annotation`. Will push shortly.

zoe (Docs): small content note: the prefetch example used `batch_size: 1024` which contradicts our hosted defaults. Changed to 64 and added a comment "example only; tune for your workload".

ci-bot: snippet-lint: WARNING in docs/snippets/observability/prefetch.sample.js: deprecated key `cost_breakdown` found

rafe (SDK): fixed the two occurrences and pushed shim + tests. Leaving TODO to remove shim after two releases. Added changelog entry.

ci-bot: PR 4277  sample-link-check OK; snippet-lint OK; preview deploy queued.

mik (Eng): preview link looks good: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-4277. Prefetch dashboard renders and the playground embed loads.

zoe (Docs): great  merging once CI finishes. I'll follow up with a redirect backfill for the moved playground path and add docs/migrations/observability-params-2026.md describing the renames and the SDK shim with a removal timeline.

anya (Observability): I'll do a quick repo grep for any other lingering `trace_hook` or `cost_breakdown` and open tiny fixes if found.

rafe (SDK): LGTM. Will remove shim after two releases and add deprecation note in the release notes.

ci-bot: Preview deploy succeeded: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-4277

zoe (Docs): thanks team! merging now. :thumbsup:
